title: Galkayo parents protest missing Somali recruits
organizer: Parents of Somali recruits missing after military training in Eritrea; no formal organization named
participants_original: Anadolu Agency reports hundreds of Somali parents; Radio Markabley describes many mothers without a number.
threshold_50_evidence: Anadolu Agency explicitly reports hundreds of parents in Galkayo streets on Jan 20, a qualitative estimate above 50. No numeric interval is inferred; Radio Markabley describes many mothers but gives no count.

title.summary: Both contemporary reports describe parents/mothers protesting over sons missing after Eritrea training.

start_date.summary: Anadolu dates the Galkayo gathering to Wednesday, Jan 20; Radio Markabley is dated Jan 20 and says it occurred that day.

start_precision.summary: Both accounts identify the calendar day as Jan 20.

end_date.summary: Neither account establishes physical departure, dissolution, or a definitive end.

location.summary: Both reports identify Galkayo; Radio Markabley refers to the city center/main roads. The region label follows its report; no sub-city boundary is assigned.

scope.summary: The action is described in Galkayo streets and roads, with no national organization reported.

organizer.summary: Accounts identify parents/mothers; neither names a formal organization.

demands.summary: Parents sought Somali-government action and answers about whether their children were alive or dead; the demand concerns Somali federal and Galmudug authorities.

participants_original.summary: Anadolu reports 'hundreds'; Radio Markabley says many mothers but provides no number.

participants_min.summary: No numeric minimum is published; no interval is inferred from 'hundreds'.

participants_max.summary: No numeric maximum is published; no interval is inferred.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Anadolu's qualitative 'hundreds' estimate supports the 50-person threshold.

protester_violence.summary: Anadolu reports tire burning, major-road blockages and running battles with police; the report does not attribute injuries to protesters.

state_response.accommodation.summary: Garowe Online and The EastAfrican report that the Galmudug security minister met parents in Galkayo and undertook to raise their case with federal offices. They disagree on whether the meeting was Wednesday or Thursday; this is an actual reception of the demand, not a claim that it was granted.

state_response.arrests.summary: Anadolu explicitly reports several protesters arrested.

state_response.beatings.summary: Available Jan20 coverage does not report beatings of demonstrators; silence does not establish none.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: Anadolu says police fired live rounds and tear gas to disperse the crowd; Radio Markabley says security forces used gunfire to disperse. The reported attempt does not establish that all protesters left.

state_response.ignore.summary: No source explicitly says officials refused or avoided the parents; remains unknown.

state_response.killings.summary: Reports discuss allegations that missing recruits died in Tigray, not deaths caused by Somali state agents responding to this protest.

state_response.shootings.summary: Anadolu reports police live rounds and Radio Markabley reports gunfire used by security forces.

notes: The reported deaths/deployment of recruits in Tigray are allegations disputed by Somali officials. Code the parents' demand for answers and government action, not the allegations as verified fact. The Jan18 Galkayo report may describe a separate gathering or the same evolving campaign; retain this candidate pending unit review. The Galmudug minister meeting is documented but its date and precise link to this particular street gathering are unclear.
open_questions: Are the Jan18 and Jan20 Galkayo accounts separate gatherings or days in one physical episode?
When did demonstrators physically depart or disperse after police force was used?
Did the Galmudug minister meeting occur on Jan20 or Jan21, and which gathering/campaign did it answer?
Are there additional documented beatings, injuries, deaths, or arrests?
Can a Somali-speaking reviewer check the translated wording and exact actor attribution?

title: Galkayo mothers and youth protest over missing recruits
organizer: Mothers and youth; no formal organization named
participants_original: Keydmedia says mothers and young people, including boys and girls, took part; Caasimada describes mothers. Neither gives a count.
threshold_50_evidence: The local reports establish a public street demonstration but give no attendance estimate. The 50-person threshold remains unverified.

title.summary: Keydmedia and Caasimada describe mothers protesting over sons taken to Eritrea for training and now missing.

start_date.summary: Keydmedia dates the report and protest to Jan 18; Caasimada's published-time metadata is Jan 18 and its body says the gathering took place that day.

end_date.summary: Neither report describes physical departure, dissolution, or an end.

location.summary: Keydmedia identifies Gaalkacyo; Caasimada calls Galkayo the site of the strongest demonstration that day.

scope.summary: Reports describe a local street gathering in Galkayo.

organizer.summary: Keydmedia says mothers and youth organized the demonstration; no group name is given.

demands.summary: Mothers sought justice and information whether their sons were alive or dead, and attributed responsibility to Somali President Farmaajo and NISA director Fahad Yasin.

participants_original.summary: Keydmedia mentions mothers and youth; Caasimada describes mostly women/mothers; neither gives attendance.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Neither local report quantifies turnout; public demonstration alone does not establish 50 participants.

protester_violence.summary: The reports do not describe violent acts by demonstrators; absence from the accounts is not an explicit no.

state_response.accommodation.summary: Neither report describes an official receiving or granting the demand at this Jan18 gathering.

state_response.arrests.summary: Neither report describes arrests at this gathering.

state_response.beatings.summary: Neither report describes beatings at this gathering.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: Neither report describes an attempt to disperse this gathering.

state_response.ignore.summary: Neither report explicitly reports official refusal or avoidance.

state_response.killings.summary: Neither report identifies a state killing in response to this gathering.

state_response.shootings.summary: Neither report describes shots fired in response to this gathering.

notes: This Jan18 account is date- and site-specific but does not provide attendance. It may be distinct from or connected to the Jan20 Galkayo event. The allegation that recruits died in Tigray remains contested and is not coded as established fact.
open_questions: Did this gathering reach 50 participants?
Was the Jan20 Galkayo report a later day in one episode or a separate action?
What physical end and state response, if any, followed this gathering?
Can the Somali-language reports be human-reviewed?
